de.abas.jfop.base.buffer

Class LockModifier

  • Object
    • LockModifier

  • public final class LockModifier
extends Object
    Representation of the FO lock modifiers. Please beware that not every combination of the lock modifiers is valid. See the FO documentation for further details. This class does not validate the modifier combinations.

    • Field Detail

      • NO_TERMINATION

        public static final int NO_TERMINATION
        This is the FO lock modifier "no termination".
        Please see the FO online help for further information.
        Sample FO commands built from usage of this mode:
        • german: 
          .HOLE ... KEINABBRUCH
        • english: 
          .SELECT ... NOTERMINATION

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values
